notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: Toggle the reference against either render. The previous render is the dist-gated recreation, and the revised one draws the print fits and the pulley chamber listed in 730-001_DiffBodyA.scad's header: the press clearance on the 6703 and 6705 seats and the arm spigot, the spacer shoulder bored to the 6705's outer race, the chamber opened for the 80T ring with two posts in place of the rib, and the screws moved out along the arm. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the renders are its output.
